divergence_justification: Judge accepted the attributed review: mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_observation_chartevents.sql:9 casts chartevents.charttime through TIMESTAMPTZ and line 67 writes the transformed value to Observation.effectiveDateTime, which is the candidate charttime source. The comparator replayed the America/New_York DST-gap transformation over all 2 conflicting charttime rows with zero residual; 2/33,474 (0.006%) is consistent with DST-gap rarity. Height values, row inclusion, natural key, grouping, and subject/stay assignment remain unchanged, so this is ancillary intrinsic upstream loss and the port is faithful as the data allows.
